entities.summary: Jonathan Paul Arencibia is an American former professional baseball catcher who is the catching coach for the New York Mets of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Toronto Blue Jays, Texas Rangers, and Tampa Bay Rays from 2010 to 2015.
